exercise: Alternative B - AI Invoice Reconciliation & Review Platform

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.309 in the Claude desktop app (Code tab) on Windows 11. Development model: Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2). Reasoning effort was lowered from extra-high to medium during day 2 to save usage; nothing else was changed from the defaults. The model of the first short session that drafted the project folder and CLAUDE.md was not recorded.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No plugins or IDE extensions were installed for this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: OpenAI Responses API, model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 (pinned snapshot), temperature 0, strict JSON schema output, image input with default detail. Used for field extraction and for draft notes. Chosen after a three-way probe recorded in docs/DEVLOG.md (day 1).

skills.notes: The starter pack's data-generation skill, unchanged, used once on day 2 for the added invoices. One user-level skill (developing-with-streamlit) was used on day 4; it only points the agent to the documentation bundled with the installed Streamlit package and is not copied here.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: CLAUDE.md is the only agent instruction file. Its history is in Git (the Reviewability section was added in commit c7218af, commands were updated as modules appeared). No subagent definitions were created or used.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Application prompts. extract_invoice_v1 is active. extract_invoice_v2 was tried against the P0-4 misread, did not help and is kept as a named snapshot together with its response in replay/history/. domain.md is the supplied rule file, unchanged.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: launch.json starts the Streamlit app for the desktop app's built-in browser preview, which was used to open the review page after changes. No other tool or MCP server affected the exercise. Other MCP connectors enabled in the user's account were not used and are omitted.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: No project permission file: tool calls were approved in the app (default and auto-approve modes), which is not exportable. Environment variable names: OPENAI_API_KEY (required for live mode only), OPENAI_MODEL (optional), INVOICE_DB (optional path of the SQLite file). .env is git-ignored.
